in_marathi.name: Dharun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharun is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dharana’, which means ‘to hold, support, or uphold’. In Hindu mythology, Dharun is the name of the divine chariot driver who carries gods and goddesses to their respective battlefields. The name signifies strength, reliability, and unwavering support.
